comments.body: Additionally, if you click Another Info #1 on certain articles, it sometimes shows helpful information you wouldn't normally see -- such as the fact that this hat is also sold in the item shops of Lisbon and Santo Domingo. Cheers; great online fashion-voyaging to you all.
